steps.en: Start your local model server, or have a provider API key ready
steps.zh: 启动本地模型服务，或准备好服务商 API key

steps.en: In Margin options, pick a provider, set endpoint and key, fetch and choose a model
steps.zh: 在 Margin 设置里选服务商，填端点和 key，拉取并选定模型

steps.en: Open a webpage and click Translate this page in the popup
steps.zh: 打开网页，在弹窗里点“Translate this page”

steps.en: Detects readable blocks and skips navigation, forms, buttons and code
steps.zh: 识别可读文本块，跳过导航、表单、按钮和代码

steps.en: Sends only uncached text segments to your endpoint, in batches
steps.zh: 只把未缓存的文本片段分批发到你配置的端点

steps.en: Inserts each translation below its source block, keeping the original in place
steps.zh: 把译文插在对应原文块下面，原文保留不动

value.en: Bilingual pages where page text goes only to the endpoint you chose — no bundled service, account, or default telemetry
value.zh: 双语网页阅读，页面文字只发往你选的端点——没有内置服务、账号或默认统计

sources: README.md Local LLMs @ main 2026-10-08: 'Start the local model server'; select OpenAI Compatible or Anthropic Compatible; Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions; click Fetch models
README.md Install From Source: 'Configure a provider, API key, model, target language, and cache behavior'; 'click Translate this page from the Margin popup'
README.md Features: detect readable text blocks; avoid navigation, forms, buttons, code blocks; insert translations below matching source blocks
docs/THREAT_MODEL.md Data Flow: content script detects blocks and sends segments to the service worker; service worker checks cache and sends uncached segments to the configured provider endpoint
